title: The Antichrist
lead: The word "antichrist" occurs only in John's letters (1 John 2:18, 22; 1 John 4:3; 2 John 7), which say that many antichrists have already come. Christians later joined it to Daniel's "little horn" (Daniel 7:8; Daniel 11:36), whose first model was Antiochus IV, to Paul's "man of lawlessness" (2 Thessalonians 2:3–12) and to Revelation's beast (Revelation 13) to describe one great enemy of Christ at the end.
